task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 (fix design) for ISS-0926. Branch feature/WF03-Q926-20261001, already checked out; do not switch. Claim: status IN_PROGRESS only. Read the Step 1 diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-Q926-20261001/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json result.summary) in full first, then the files in artifacts_in.
Write ONE design doc at lib/letflow/design/iss0926-service-task-body-template-rendering.md (design only, no implementation code beyond signatures/@specs/shapes). It must decide and specify:
 1. Rendering: render config.body_template at activation (variables in scope, engine.ex ~967-995), freeze as config_snapshot["rendered_body"] (parity with rendered_url, incl. the ISS-0917 catalog path decision: where does a catalog node's body_template come from; the inline and catalog paths must both be addressed or the catalog limit explicitly stated), and make the dispatcher send the frozen rendered_body instead of the raw template (dispatcher ~719/741). State the exact placeholder syntax ({{variables.KEY}} as the URL renderer), the nil/missing-variable behaviour, and how existing frozen snapshots that lack rendered_body (rows created before this change) are handled (fallback must be backward compatible and safe - say which).
 2. Escaping/injection (SECURITY): adopt diagnosis option A (per-value JSON-string escaping, placeholders only inside quoted strings) unless you find a concrete flaw; specify exactly: how values are stringified (strings, numbers, booleans, nil, maps/lists), JSON escape of quote/backslash/control chars/U+2028-9 etc (e.g. Jason.encode! then strip outer quotes), what happens to a placeholder that is NOT inside a JSON string (reject at activation with a typed error vs leave literal - choose, justify), whether the rendered result must be validated as decodable JSON when content-type is JSON, size cap on rendered body, and the error path (mirror build_service_task_empty_url_error/catalog-unresolved error: a typed, non-leaking error, never the variable value). Also confirm the URL renderer is NOT changed in behaviour (do not widen scope), and secrets/variables must not leak into logs/audit beyond what rendered_url already does (decide whether rendered_body is stored in config_snapshot; since snapshot is persisted state consider PII - decide and justify).
 3. Fixture: split regulatory-auto-escalation so the two inbound paths get distinct bodies without a lib engine node-type change: e.g. keep node id regulatory-auto-escalation for the 21-day timeout path with body {"reason":"sla_breach_30_days", "review_id": "{{variables.<the variable that exists>}}"}  (check which instance variables really exist) and add a second SERVICE_TASK (e.g. regulatory-remediation-escalation) reached by e10 with body reason 'remediation_unresolved' (or whatever the BA scenario/regulation wording supports; read test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/meridian/regulatory-compliance-review-bafin.yaml and docs for the e10 semantics), both -> end-closed; retarget edges; bump fixture version 1.2 -> 1.3; list exactly which other files reference the fixture shape (test/fixtures/simulation/meridian/process_policy_binding.yaml, scripts/seed_meridian_definition.sh header, existing tests incl. Q915 T8/M9 which currently forbid a body on that node and node counts/edge ids in tests) and what each needs. Check graph validation (validate_graph / node attributes / edge conditions) accepts the new shape, and that the UAT scenario's other steps (EO-xxx referencing node ids, scripts/ seeds) stay consistent. Also state clearly what EO-002's verification method (audit_event with payload containing reason) can observe, per the diagnosis note that the engine may not audit the outbound body: say whether this fix can make EO-002 satisfiable, and if not, name the residual gap as a follow-up (do not expand scope to build audit of outbound bodies; recommend filing an issue).
 4. Public surface: list every new/changed function with @spec and visibility (prefer private defp in engine.ex or a small pure public helper in Letflow.Engine.ServiceTask that is unit-testable without DB, e.g. render_body_template/2 returning {:ok, String.t()} | {:error, reason}); state it is MINOR, no migration, no supervision files, whether config_snapshot shape change needs any schema/migration (it is a map column: say so with evidence).
 5. Decision records: grep docs/migration/decisions for anything touching SERVICE_TASK dispatch/SSRF/secrets/templating and state consistency (the diagnosis found none settling body rendering; confirm; if a new decision record is warranted, say so and justify - do not write one unless needed).
 6. Test plan the TEST-DESIGNER should follow: unit tests of the pure renderer (injection cases: quote, backslash, newline, unicode, nested map value, nil, missing key, placeholder outside quotes, oversize), integration test that the dispatcher transport receives the rendered body (check how existing service task engine tests stub transport - note Postgres may be unreachable on this machine; say which tests need DB), fixture tests (new nodes, version 1.3, bodies, both inbound paths), and the regression test that fails pre-fix. Also an owned_modules list for this run.
Docs only: modify nothing except the design doc and this handoff. Complete handoff PASS, next_action 'Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR'; commit with git add of those two files only, push origin HEAD. Do not touch handoffs/registry.json or orchestrator.log.
acceptance_criteria: Rendering location + frozen snapshot + dispatcher change specified incl. catalog path and legacy rows
Fixture split specified with version bump and full list of affected files/tests
EO-002 observability gap stated with follow-up recommendation
@specs and visibility listed, no implementation code

result.summary: Design written: lib/letflow/design/iss0926-service-task-body-template-rendering.md. Decisions: render body_template at activation via new pure ServiceTask.render_body_template/2 (option A per-value JSON-string escaping, Jason escape :javascript_safe, placeholders only inside quoted strings, else typed :placeholder_outside_string), freeze as config_snapshot[rendered_body] (no migration; map column); dispatcher sends rendered_body; legacy snapshots: static template sent as-is, templated template fails closed as request_build_error. Missing variable key = typed error, nil = empty string; 64 KiB cap; decode validation when placeholders present; new body_render_error tuple mirrors catalog_resolution_error at all sites. Catalog path covered by the same shared step (body_template is a node attribute). Fixture v1.3: keep regulatory-auto-escalation (timer, sla_breach_30_days), new regulatory-remediation-escalation (e10, remediation_unresolved), new edge e18; affected files/tests listed. EO-002: cannot be literal (no outbound audit); observable via SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED decoded_body.json.reason with httpbin echo; follow-up issue recommended. No new decision record. Test plan T-R1..19, I-1..13, fixture T8/T13/T14/M9a-d; owned_modules listed. Nothing run (docs only).
